environment.description: Same Django application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Split.io SDK initialized with API key for a workspace where the targeting rule for 'enable-legacy-hmac-jwt-verification' evaluates to 'off' for all identities (the flag's default rule was set to 'off' on 2024-01-15 and the 'on' treatment has zero individual targets and zero segment-based rules). The Split SDK is configured with impressionsMode='OPTIMIZED' and the factory initialization uses a read-only API key scoped to the 'production-gated' environment. The flag definition has a kill switch engaged (killed=true) which forces the default treatment ('off') regardless of targeting rules. Note: the application code still contains the HS256 verification path and the SECRET_KEY is identical to the exploitable environment.
